body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #285 head 015929c8 (branch pushed by codex-standard-dot-a006 over SSH; PR opened by the orchestrator because the seat's worker gh credential is not provisioned, the condition this change reports). Re-derived from the diff: notice_missing_worker_github_credential() builds the path from the existing worker_github_config_dir helper, tests only file presence (no credential read or printed), prints one stderr line and returns; the --add-worker call sits before write_spawn_options and after the main-checkout check (line 2158), and the shared call (line 2541) is reached only by full and --restart-worker: --bootstrap-agmsg, --add/--remove-worker, --audit and --attach all exit earlier (2092, 2233, 2262, 2434, 2469/2538), so no other mode gains the line. Four tests pin exactly one notice per mode with unchanged stdout and exit status, and silence with a configured '~/custom gh/hosts.yml' present. README: one sentence in the provisioning paragraph; T82b's hook-trust section untouched. 3 files, +76/-1; validator rc=0, shellcheck and bash -n clean, 881 unit tests OK in the worker's pasted output.
